isolation.mechanism: Clean CODEX_HOME containing only auth.json (no AGENTS.md, CODEX_TASKS.md, memories, skills, or config.toml) + --skip-git-repo-check --ephemeral --ignore-user-config --ignore-rules -s read-only in empty /tmp directory

Run in empty /tmp directory with --mode plan --sandbox and no --add-dir; no project-level GEMINI.md or Claude auto-memory is reachable; global ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md contains only general workflow preferences and zero taxonomy terms (verified by leak scan).

phase2_blind_rubric_and_citation_screen.reference_knowledge_citation_screen: No primary sources were opened; verdicts rest on the supplied local check and reference knowledge, so upheld means consistent with reference knowledge, and ISO pinpoints remain unconfirmed. Grouped rows state how many citations they cover. Totals: Method-A 36 checked (31 upheld, 5 downgraded, 0 vacated); Method-B 112 checked (108 upheld, 4 downgraded, 0 vacated); Method-C 79 checked (45 upheld, 33 downgraded, 1 vacated). The local check is not a valid clause audit because it mixes in internal section numbers, ISO clauses and the standard's own name. Method-A is the most reliable. Method-B has a strong bibliography but cites standards by topic and does not apply its provenance tags. Method-C needs correction before adoption, especially its nonexistent SKOS properties, wrong Cimino numbers, squared MASI distance, wrong Z39.19 topics, conflated MLPerf citation, and unconfirmed single-child and IEEE P3116 claims.

phase5_curated_summary_quote_audit.curated_summary_caveat: Phase 4 prose source cards were author-curated topical summaries rather than verbatim primary-document excerpts; for example, P4-S3-SGLANG-2024 compressed SGLang's 'constrained decoding' (arXiv:2312.07104) as 'grammar-constrained decoding', and P4-S2-CMU11868-02 summarized grammar/JSON-schema mask compilation as 'compiling JSON schemas or context-free grammars into token-masking finite-state automata' (whereas unrestricted CFGs require pushdown/Earley-style stacks rather than pure finite-state automata).

unit_accounting.cov_systems_venues_2026_author_metadata_: taxonomy/coverage/systems-venues-2026.yml records accepted paper titles and venue codes (OSDI, NSDI, EuroSys, ASPLOS 2026) without full per-paper author rosters; author-overlap filtering on those 73 paper-title units could not be verified retrospectively, whereas prospective campaigns require single-work external clusters with explicit primary/senior author lists.

updated_concepts.label: Benchmark protocol
updated_concepts.before_definition: A reproducible specification of workload, measurement boundary, run rules, and comparison procedure that lets results from different systems be compared and lets a system be judged against a baseline.
updated_concepts.after_definition: A reproducible specification of workload, measurement boundary, run rules, and comparison procedure that lets results from different systems be compared and lets a system be judged against a baseline.

updated_concepts.label: Online experimentation
updated_concepts.before_definition: A controlled intervention used to estimate effects on deployed-system outcomes.
updated_concepts.after_definition: A controlled intervention used to estimate effects on deployed-system outcomes.

updated_concepts.label: Selective prediction
updated_concepts.before_definition: Predicting on admitted cases and abstaining or deferring the rest.
updated_concepts.after_definition: Decision-gating mechanism that emits model outputs only for admitted cases and abstains on or defers the remaining cases.

updated_concepts.label: Constrained decoding
updated_concepts.before_definition: Masking disallowed tokens at each step, typically from a grammar or schema automaton, so output satisfies a structural constraint.
updated_concepts.after_definition: Generation-control mechanism that masks disallowed tokens at each step, typically via a grammar or schema automaton, so generated output conforms to a required syntax or schema.

withdrawn_candidate_aliases.reason: Withdrawn during primary-source verification: Zheng et al., SGLang (NeurIPS 2024, arXiv:2312.07104) uses 'constrained decoding' rather than 'grammar-constrained decoding'; the phrase appeared only in the author-curated Phase 4 summary card P4-S3-SGLANG-2024 (passage_kind='curated_summary').

concepts_update.definition: Generation-control mechanism that masks disallowed tokens at each step, typically via a grammar or schema automaton, so generated output conforms to a required syntax or schema.
concepts_update.edge_impact_note: Checked against the baseline definition ('Masking disallowed tokens at each step, typically from a grammar or schema automaton, so output satisfies a structural constraint.') and all 3 incident relationships (constrained-decoding implements mlsys.grammar, mlsys.output-validation is the post-hoc alternative to constrained-decoding, and constrained-decoding enables mlsys.function-calling): adds a genus, replaces label-echoing 'structural constraint' with 'required syntax or schema' in line with the structured-generation subject definition, and retains token masking and typical grammar or schema automaton guidance without shifting extension.

concepts_update.definition: Decision-gating mechanism that emits model outputs only for admitted cases and abstains on or defers the remaining cases.
concepts_update.edge_impact_note: Checked against the baseline definition ('Predicting on admitted cases and abstaining or deferring the rest.') and all 8 incident relationships on mlsys.selective-prediction (calibration, conformal-prediction, model-cascade, cost-sensitive-decision, ood-detection, predictive-uncertainty, semi-supervised-learning, and human-oversight): adds a genus and replaces label-echoing 'Predicting' with emitting model outputs while keeping baseline 'admitted cases' and abstain-or-defer semantics intact across runtime requests, cascade deferral, human escalation, and confidence-filtered pseudo-labeling.

concepts_update.remove_aliases_rationale: Removes named multi-benchmark suite family 'MLPerf' (maintained by MLCommons; Gate 3 product/benchmark exclusion, Z39.19 section 6.3.3) and multi-protocol collection 'benchmark suite' (not equivalent to a single benchmark protocol, Z39.19 section 8.2).

Removes planning/governance document 'preregistered analysis plan', which is a specification artifact used by an experiment rather than an equivalence term for Online experimentation (Z39.19 section 8.2).

subject_updates.rationale: On-device deployment on edge SoCs, mobile NPUs, and microcontrollers under kilobyte SRAM ceilings relies on static arena memory planning to avoid heap fragmentation (dev unit P4-S2-MIT65940-01, S2), homed in Stack area S2 (ml-compilers).

cited_dev_unit_records.locator: Lectures 15-17: Structured Generation, RAG Serving, and Compound AI
cited_dev_unit_records.passage: Production LLM endpoints enforce output syntax via constrained decoding (compiling JSON schemas or context-free grammars into token-masking finite-state automata), orchestrate retrieval-augmented generation (vector indexing, approximate nearest-neighbor search, reranking, prompt assembly), and route queries across model cascades based on difficulty and cost.

cited_dev_unit_records.source_title: MIT 6.5940 TinyML and Efficient Deep Learning Computing (Fall 2024)
cited_dev_unit_records.locator: Lectures 4-8 & 14: Post-Training Quantization, Weight-Only INT4, and On-Device LLM Serving
cited_dev_unit_records.passage: Deploying models on edge SoCs, mobile NPUs, and microcontrollers requires post-training quantization (calibration, per-channel scaling, activation-aware weight quantization), static arena memory planning to avoid heap fragmentation under kilobyte SRAM ceilings, operator delegate fallback partitioning, and KV-cache eviction or streaming sinks for long contexts on device.

cited_dev_unit_records.source_title: Zheng et al., SGLang: Efficient Execution of Structured Language Model Programs (NeurIPS 2024)
cited_dev_unit_records.locator: Sections 3-4: RadixAttention Prefix Caching and Compressed Finite-State Jump-Forward Decoding
cited_dev_unit_records.passage: Multi-turn agentic workflows, few-shot prompts, and tree-of-thought programs repeatedly share prompt prefixes. RadixAttention retains KV-cache blocks in an LRU radix tree across requests for automatic prefix reuse, while compressed finite-state machines fast-forward deterministic multi-token spans during grammar-constrained decoding.

cited_dev_unit_records.locator: Modules on Certified Robustness, Input/Output Guardrails, and Red-Teaming
cited_dev_unit_records.passage: Assuring deployed ML systems combines pre-deployment adversarial stress testing and automated red-teaming with formal verification (SMT/MILP/bound propagation and randomized smoothing LP radii) and runtime input/output safety filters, content classifiers, and selective abstention when uncertainty or out-of-distribution indicators trip.
